title: SnapshotAdapter
responsibility: Exports one exact commit into a clean directory outside every repository and detects files a check changed.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.create.root
inputs.description: The repository root passed to the Git archive and commit-tree adapters. It matters when exporting the selected commit and loading its tracked tree.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.create.commit
inputs.description: The revision passed to git archive and CommitTreeAdapter.open so the exported files and tracked tree refer to the same commit. The adapter passes the string through without rewriting it.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.create.outputs
inputs.description: Path patterns checked against tracked files and used to exclude covered additions from drift results. Each pattern is passed to pathMatches.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.link.root
inputs.description: The checkout root used to locate the source path for a shared link. The source must exist under this root for a link to be created.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.link.path
inputs.description: The path joined under the checkout and snapshot directories for the shared symlink. The operation returns false if the source is absent, the snapshot target exists, or its parent directory is absent.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.artifact.path
inputs.description: The path resolved against the snapshot directory before reading an artifact's byte count and SHA-256. The result is undefined when the resolved path is outside the snapshot or cannot be read.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.retainArtifact.sourcePath
inputs.description: The canonical relative path of a declared generated output inside the snapshot.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.retainArtifact.runDirectory
inputs.description: The private verification run directory chosen by Harness.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.create
outputs.description: A newly exported SnapshotAdapter instance for the requested commit. It is available after archive extraction, tracked-tree loading, and the initial hash comparison complete.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.link
outputs.description: Whether a symlink was created in the snapshot. It is false when the source is missing, the target already exists, or the target parent is absent.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.misdeclared
outputs.description: Each result identifies one declared output pattern and the first tracked file that pattern covers. Patterns with no tracked match are omitted.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.drift
outputs.description: The result lists tracked paths or shared links that changed or disappeared, plus uncovered files added to the snapshot. Mutated paths include tracked files whose contents changed and shared links replaced from their original targets.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.artifact
outputs.type: Promise<{ bytes: number; sha256: string } | undefined>
outputs.description: The result contains the readable file's byte count and SHA-256, or undefined. It is undefined for paths outside the snapshot and for files that cannot be read.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.remove
outputs.description: The operation resolves after recursively removing the snapshot directory with force enabled.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.retainArtifact
outputs.description: Returns the relative evidence path, original path, exact bytes count and SHA-256 for a regular file of 1 byte to 64 MiB. Returns undefined if the file is missing or ineligible.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The adapter propagates failures from awaited filesystem, Git, and snapshot-scanning operations. Tar process errors are forwarded, and a nonzero tar exit is converted to an Error containing captured stderr.

errors.name: Destination write failure
errors.description: An unexpected error opening or writing the new artifact file rejects the promise.
